subject: Dedicated capacity proposal + load test packet for Atlas AI
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Emma Chen <emma@atlasai.com>
Date: 2026-11-12T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Dedicated capacity proposal + load test packet for Atlas AI

Hi Emma,

Thanks again for running the pilot with us last week. Per our call I pulled together the load test artifacts and a first-pass commercial that maps to the throughput you asked for. Attachments: loadtest-summary.pdf (high-level charts) and throughput-traces-20261111.zip (raw traces + collected p95/p99 slices). You can also view the interactive dashboards here: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/bench/atlas-loadtest-20261111.

Executive summary (short):
- Goal: support Atlas inference surface for realtime ranking + assistant use-case with target sustained throughput of ~320 TPS (mixed prompts, avg seq len ~120 tokens).
- Observed during controlled load tests (mixed batching profile): sustained 320 TPS with p95 latency ~180 ms using 8x A100-80GB equivalent pool (vCPU and NVMe tuned). Peak bursts to 550 TPS observed for short windows (<=2min) with our autoscaling/burst config.
- Suggested Dedicated sizing: 8 reserved GPU pods (A100-equivalent) with a 12-month commit; automatic burst pool to cover short spikes (no extra reservation required).

Commercial (initial):
- List price for proposed pool: $240,000 / month (base dedicated pool rate).
- Proposed committed discount: 25% off list for 12-month reserved commit -> $180,000 / month.
- Commitment: 12 months, monthly billing, SLA target p95 < 250 ms for sustained traffic; credits for SLA breaches as standard.

Open questions for you:
1) Do you want a 3 or 12 month contract term? (3-month gives smaller discount, 12-month is where we can be aggressive).
2) Do you need the private deployment/VPC option (adds a one-time onboarding + network ETL fee)?
3) Any procurement constraints (POs, SOWs, specific PO language)?

Next step: if the numbers look close, I can share an itemized pricing workbook and a formal commitment addendum for review.

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call to walk the dashboard.

—
Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: loadtest-summary.pdf (3 pages), throughput-traces-20261111.zip (50MB, traces + scripts)

From: Emma Chen <emma@atlasai.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-12T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity proposal + load test packet for Atlas AI

Neha,

Appreciate the packet and the quick turn. A few quick clarifying questions:
- Is the 320 TPS number per model endpoint or aggregated across 3 endpoints (ranking / assistant / reranker)? We plan to run three endpoints concurrently.
- Can you break down the recommended pool into compute-equivalent units? Our infra team wants an apples-to-apples (H100/A100 equivalence).
- On pricing: 25% off looks fine as an anchor. Our CFO will push for deeper discount if we commit 24 months. What flexibility do you have on term+discount?

Also, we will need an itemized workbook for procurement (line items that we can plug into our SOW). Can you send that?

I can do a quick sync Friday if you want to walk the dashboard together.

—
Emma Chen
Head of Infrastructure Partnerships | Atlas AI
emma@atlasai.com

Subject: Fwd: Dedicated capacity proposal + load test packet for Atlas AI

Folks — forwarding the customer thread. Key asks: clarity on how we present GPU equivalence, and pricing flexibility for term length. I recommend we:

1) Offer a 12-month aggressive commercial at 22% discount if Atlas signs within 10 business days.
2) Provide a 24-month alternate at 28% discount (requires VP approval; also increases onboarding fee credit).
3) Itemize a "Committed Pool" workbook that maps GPUs -> equivalent "Redwood Reserved Units" so procurement can compare to H100/A100 listings. See quick notes from the load test below.

Load test excerpts (engineering notes):
- Bench config: mixed prompt profile, avg seq 120 tokens; tail-heavy reranker calls (~20% of requests generate a second model call).
- A100-equivalent perf: ~40-45 TPS per GPU when using continuous batching for ranking model (seq 96). Larger assistant model with kv-cache hit-rate 0.6 delivered ~18-22 TPS per GPU. Hybrid pool sizing yields blended ~32-40 TPS per GPU. Our recommended 8 GPUs -> sustained 320 TPS (includes batching improvements and autoscaler burst).
- p95 observed: 140–220 ms depending on modeled traffic skew. We report 180 ms as a conservative production expectation.

Attachments for internal: loadtest-20261111-grafana.pdf (screenshots + notes), throughput-traces-20261111.zip (raw traces). Also drafting a pricing workbook: redwood-dedicated-pricing-v2.xlsx.

If we land at 22%/12mo I propose we hold the $180k/month anchor (internal list $230–$245k). Comments? Rishi can you check margin math and approvals needed? Markus — can you confirm the SLA language for p95 and the required crediting model?

—
Neha

Attachments (internal): loadtest-20261111-grafana.pdf, throughput-traces-20261111.zip, redwood-dedicated-pricing-v2.xlsx

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Fwd: Dedicated capacity proposal + load test packet for Atlas AI

Neha — quick thoughts:
- Margin check: 22% discount at $180k/month gives us ~38% gross margin after infra & ops allocation for the pool size you listed. That passes basic thresholds but leaves limited room for additional onboarding credits.
- Approvals: 22% can be approved by AE lead; anything >25% needs commercial director sign-off. 28% for 24 months will need VP and legal on SOW language about termination protection.
- SLA: Markus — confirm that p95 < 250 ms SLA is covered by our monitoring + tracing hooks. Also we need to document how we calculate "sustained traffic" (sliding window definition) to avoid edge disputes.

Minor edit to external messaging: call out the H100 equivalence explicitly and offer the alternate 24-month price as an "if-signed" option. I'll loop legal after we have the named term.

—
Rishi

From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Emma Chen <emma@atlasai.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-15T16:04:00-08:00
Subject: Revised commercial + itemized workbook (Atlas AI)

Emma — thanks for the quick note and great questions. Attached is the itemized workbook (redwood-dedicated-pricing-v2.xlsx) and a short summary PDF. Key updates: 

- Clarification on throughput: the 320 TPS number is aggregated across the three endpoints (ranking + assistant + reranker) with the load profile you shared. We modeled per-endpoint fragmentation and included the extra KV/cache calls in the blended TPS.
- Hardware equivalence: our "A100-equivalent" is calibrated to H100 throughput using the following mapping in the workbook (A100-equivalent = 1.0; H100 ~ 1.35x perf for the assistant model profile). The workbook includes per-GPU TPS estimates and the math that produced the 8-GPU recommendation.
- Commercial terms (final proposed):
    * 12-month term — $180,000 / month (22% off list).
    * 24-month term — $165,600 / month (28% off list; requires VP approval).
    * Onboarding: one-time $12,000 (waived if 24-month).
    * SLA: p95 < 250 ms for sustained traffic windows (defined in workbook); credits spelled out in SOW.

Next steps:
1) If you want to proceed, I can send a formal commitment addendum via DocuSign (here: https://app.docusign.com/DocuSign/envelope12345) and open a HubSpot deal (https://hubspot.com/deals/ATL-2026-11-72) we can both reference.
2) If procurement needs further line-item changes, tell me the FOA format and I’ll update the workbook.

If helpful, Rishi and Markus can join a 30-min call Friday to walk through the workbook and dashboard — let me know a time.

Best,
Neha
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood-dedicated-pricing-v2.xlsx (pricing workbook), loadtest-20261111-grafana.pdf (summary screenshots)
